cohort: 33 neonates with severe RDS undergoing mechanical ventilation at Naqu People's Hospital in Tibet (4,580 m above sea level) and 66 neonates with severe RDS undergoing mechanical ventilation at Shengjing Hospital in Liaoning (51 m above sea level)
finding: Mechanical ventilation parameters (PIP, PEEP, FiO2) were significantly higher in neonates with RDS at high altitude compared to those at lower altitude.
